title: Demographic-noise predator-prey cycles (McKane and Newman, 2005)
reference: McKane AJ, Newman TJ (2005). Predator-prey cycles from resonant amplification of demographic stochasticity. Phys Rev Lett 94:218102. doi:10.1103/PhysRevLett.94.218102
notes: Fig. 1 parameters of the paper (N=3200, b=0.1, d1=0.1, d2=0, p1=0.25, p2=0.05; 800 predators and 800 prey initially). Individual trajectories cycle persistently with random phase, so the replicate mean is a damped oscillation whose fixed point, frequency and damping carry the four rates; the noise the fit averages over is the phase spread of the cycles.
